name: model_label
label: Model
description: Always 'gpt-oss-20b, reasoning effort medium' (gpt-oss-only table: the adapter refuses any other model).

name: reasoning_effort
label: Reasoning effort
description: Always 'medium': gpt-oss-20b has no thinking-off mode, so no t0/t1 contrast exists.

name: empty_talk_done_count
label: Empty talk replies read as done
description: Talk turns whose empty reply the engine read as 'done' (a silence) under the gpt-oss option empty_talk_as_done (unit E1); a covariate. Blank for games not done.

name: arm_build_bug
label: Arm build bug
description: 1 for the five planned formula / no-numbers arms that played the neutral headline prompt because of a global grid override; 0 otherwise.

name: headline_replicate_of
label: Headline replicate of
description: For arm_build_bug rows, the headline cell (arm__p<point>) whose prompt they played; blank otherwise.
